title.en: A grocer receives constraints, never the household's facts

goal.en: The Household Context Profile keeps a home's facts at home. Derive what a grocer may receive from a full household context and confirm that the raw facets about children and health stay withheld.

note.en: Run the derivation for the grocer role over the example household (an allergy, a child, a budget, a delivery window among the facets).
A meal planner may receive more constraint types than a grocer, still never a raw facet.
The constraint list carries types and the facet ids it was derived from; no facet value appears.

outcome.en: You know the shape of a DerivedConstraint and why providers plug in as peers without seeing the home. Next: scenario 030 adds a consent grant for a device self-state facet.
